treatments_received.treatment: A&E Department and transfer to Orthopaedics & Traumatology Department
source: The applicant was rushed to the A&E Department of Princess Margaret Hospital in an ambulance for treatment. Being seriously injured, he was immediately transferred to the Orthopaedics & Traumatology Department for follow-up.

treatments_received.treatment: Right wrist surgery (three occasions: 26 June 2015, 9 July 2015 and 7 September 2015)
source: In respect of the fracture on his right wrist, he underwent surgery on three occasions, on 26 June 2015, 9 July 2015 and 7 September 2015 respectively.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Closed reduction for Colles' fracture with percutaneous k-wire fixation

treatments_received.treatment: One operation for the comminuted fracture on the left elbow
source: He had one operation for the comminuted fracture on the left elbow,
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Open reduction for arm / leg / patella / scapula +/- internal fixation

treatments_received.treatment: Two operations for the comminuted fracture of his left humerus
source: while he underwent two operations for the comminuted fracture of his left humerus.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Open reduction for arm / leg / patella / scapula +/- internal fixation

treatments_received.treatment: Occupational therapy at Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital
source: On 19 September 2015, the applicant was discharged from hospital, where arrangements were made for him to receive physiotherapy and occupational therapy at Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital.
